status: PRE-REGISTERED before any C2/C3 model or benchmark error was computed (data extraction, reconciliation and coverage checks only)

common.forecast_origin: quarter end + 10 days (same as ITMG-C1). Nowcast of the just-ended quarter, before ITMG's release (39-57 days after quarter end).
common.information_set: ITMG decks and FS for quarters published before the origin (q-1 and earlier), including sales guidance printed in deck q-1; World Bank CMO monthly Newcastle and Brent through the quarter's last month

data_scope_exclusions.production_volume: excluded: deck charts do not yield a reliable quarterly series by automated extraction (mine-level vs total ambiguity)
data_scope_exclusions.mine_rainfall: excluded: mine coordinates not verified (decks show regions only); no satellite rainfall used

common.inference: Diebold-Mariano (absolute loss, Newey-West lag floor(n^(1/3)), HLN correction, one-sided); 90% moving-block bootstrap CI of the MAE ratio (block 4, 5000 reps, seed 20261125)
common.pass_rule: n >= 16 AND MAE(model) <= 0.85 x MAE(strongest benchmark) AND Holm-adjusted (within experiment) one-sided DM p <= 0.05
common.programme_multiplicity: results also reported with Holm across all programme tests (programme_multiplicity.csv); a pass that does not survive is labelled CONDITIONAL
common.change_policy: no changes after results; variants need new registration and prospective evaluation

C2.target: quarterly coal sales volume (Mt) = standalone coal revenue (FS Note 'Net revenue': coal third + related parties, USD k) / first-reported ASP (USD/t). Reconciled to deck-reported sales volume in 8 quarters: median gap 0.4%, max 1.1%. Production volume is NOT the target.
C2.guidance_rule: from deck q-1: FY target (year of q) -> remaining = target - sales YTD through q-1; Q target for q -> that value; H1 target (year of q, used for Q2) -> H1 - Q1 sales; if no guidance for q's year is known at the origin -> guidance-based forecasts are missing for that quarter

benchmarks.B4_guidance_runrate: remaining guidance spread evenly over the remaining quarters of the year (Q/H1 types as per guidance_rule)

models.C2_M1_guidance_seasonal_allocation: remaining guidance allocated to quarter q by the expanding average historical share of q in the remaining quarters of the year (shares from completed years before the origin)
models.C2_M2_guidance_regression: OLS sales_t = a + b B4_t + c sales_(t-1), expanding window (min 12 obs)

C2.materiality: MAE reduction (Mt) x first-reported ASP(q-1) x (1 - 0.12 royalty) >= 2% of the median quarterly gross profit (FS revenue - cost of revenue) of the test sample

C3.target: unit cost of revenue excluding royalty (USD/t) = (cost of revenue - royalty) / C2 sales volume, standalone quarter. Includes purchased coal and inventory change (both on a sold-tonne basis) so numerator and denominator are consistent; royalty excluded because it is a price-linked regulatory charge (modelled separately in any integrated model).

benchmarks.B4_rolling4: mean of the last 4 reported quarters

models.C3_M1_commodity_regression: dlog UC_t = a + b1 dlog Newcastle_t + b2 dlog Brent_t, OLS expanding window (min 12 obs); forecast UC(q-1) x exp(fitted)
models.C3_M2_component_scaling: UC_hat = [UC(q-1) - PC(q-1)] + PC(q-1) x Newcastle_q / Newcastle_(q-1), PC = coal purchases / sales volume (commodity-linked purchased coal scaled; other costs held at last quarter)

C3.materiality: MAE reduction (USD/t) x median sales volume >= 2% of the median quarterly gross profit of the test sample

evaluation_window: common sample per experiment where all benchmarks and models exist, 2021Q1 or later; n reported
royalty_note: Effective royalty rate (royalty / coal revenue) is reported descriptively; entity regimes (CCOW 13.5% vs IUP/IUPK progressive) documented in coal_regulatory_regimes.csv; royalty is not part of C3 to avoid double-counting.
